status: pilot; child trial and external scientific review pending
assets: Original virtual counts, prose, questions and CSS grid. No external observations, figures or source prose copied.

source.title: OpenStax Biology 2e: Population Demography
source.use: Quadrat sampling, defined populations and representativeness; dataset itself is fictional.

dataset.name: meadowGrid
dataset.origin: Original fictional local meadow, not measured New Zealand ecological observations.

model: One species at one time; all cells equal area. Distinct visible individuals assumed, with no uncertain species identification, boundary overlap, clonality or detectability simulated. Seeded pseudo-random shuffle draws without replacement. Random sampling does not guarantee one accurate estimate; selected cells are never labelled random. No rainfall, light or genotype effects are inferred from position alone. Revealed teaching census is not normally known in field sampling.
interaction: Choose random sample6/12 or manual cells; inspect raw count table; calculate density and total; compare roadside sample; optionally reveal census. The CSS grid provides keyboard buttons and text alternatives.
assessment: Numeric estimate accepts rounding within0.5 plants. Free-text reports are checked only for filled structure, not scientific or linguistic correctness. Five cross-unit questions have explanatory feedback and revisits.
storage: Additive S03 draft in study-biology-v1; edits invalidate saved work. S01/S02 shapes and stage counts remain independent.
export: Full bilingual UTF-8 plain-text report; student writing is not executed or rendered as HTML.
